_comment: Folium Release Resource Audit Policy. NOT a static resource list — rules are applied to resources dynamically extracted from plugin/feature source code (default_js/default_css) as the single source of truth.

classes._comment: Per-class audit policies. All classes listed in folium.plugins.__all__ and features module are scanned automatically; these are exceptions to defaults.

no_resources_expected.reason: Inherits from MacroElement only; no CDN resources, uses inline image URLs
Inherits from MacroElement only; CDN URL for icon is inside Jinja template
Inherits from MacroElement only; no own CDN resources
Inherits from MacroElement only; no own CDN resources
Inherits from JSCSSMixin but has empty default_js/default_css intentionally
Dynamic resource selection based on schema version at render time; checked via dedicated VegaLite variant check
Inherits from FeatureGroup; no own CDN resources. TopoJSON is handled by TopoJson class

inherit_resources_from.reason: Subclass inherits default_js/default_css from MarkerCluster; not a separate resource declaration
Subclass inherits default_js from _BaseFromEncoded; not a separate resource declaration
Subclass inherits default_js from _BaseFromEncoded; not a separate resource declaration
Subclass has its own default_js that overrides any parent; checked as standalone

dynamic_resource_classes.reason: VegaLite embeds different CDN URLs per schema version variant

ignore_inline_cdn_locations.reason: CDN URL for icon is inside template, not default_js/default_css; belongs to ScrollZoomToggler plugin

docs._reason: Docs may show users how to override Leaflet URL or use custom libraries (dayjs) in examples — these are intentional demos, not version drift. But library-specific version mismatches (e.g. leaflet-fullscreen@1.6.0 vs plugin@3.0.0) should be flagged.

strict._comment: Which warning categories are promoted to errors in --strict mode (used for release gate).
